title: 5.11 Buying Things
unit_outcome: Name fruit, food and drinks, say what you like, want and need, ask how many and how much, and order politely at a café.
goal: Say what you buy and pay, ask and say the price, and say that something is cheap or expensive.
grammar_function: I buy + thing; I pay + number + dollars; What is the price? The price is + number + dollars; The + thing + is + cheap/expensive; The price is the same/different.
prerequisite: 2.3 bag, book; 2.6 numbers; 2.11 same, different; 4.11 find, give; 5.2 bread; 5.3 milk; 5.8 dollars and How much is ...?
speaking_outcome: Say I buy bread., I pay five dollars., The price is two dollars. and The bag is cheap.
